QuestInfo.name: Time Hides the Answers
QuestInfo.0: Will told #p2400005# and #p2400006# that one of them had been corrupted, and because of the corruption, neither of them could become a true Transcendent. They left for #b#m328000000##k. Maybe #b#p2480000##k had some kind of advice.
QuestInfo.1: The #p2480000# claimed to be a simple priest, and suggested they talk to the #b#p2480001##k.
QuestInfo.2: The #p2480001#'s claims that a corrupted being could not truly become a Transcendent upset #p2400005#, but #p2400006# was able to calm him down.

0.0: Welcome to the Goddess Temple. Are you lost? What brings a would-be Transcendent to this place? Are you... lacking in something?
0.1: I am only a temple keeper, a priest of this place... I am not qualified to teach you anything, corrupted beings. I can tell you who is though.

yes.0: Speak to the #bMemory Keeper#k? He has observed Memory Lane for as long as anyone could remember. I bet he'd know something. If you don't know him... I can tell you about others.

npc.0: Speak to the #bMemory Keeper#k? He has observed Memory Lane for as long as anyone could remember. I bet he'd know something. If you don't know him... I can tell you about others.
